section.title: Access lists (ACL)
section.intro: Each line is one IOS entry, checked from top to bottom: the first match decides, and anything that matches no line is denied. An empty list allows everything.
section.name: Name or number
section.nameHint: 1-99 / 1300-1999 standard, 100-199 / 2000-2699 extended, or a name such as BLOCK_WEB.
section.entriesHint: Like the CLI without the sequence number, e.g. "permit 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255", "deny tcp any host 10.0.0.5 eq www", "remark Staff only".

errors.nameInvalid: A name is one word that does not start with a digit; a number must be in the ranges of the chosen type.
errors.nameDuplicate: Another access list already has this name.

problems.action: Line {{line}}: start with permit, deny or remark.
problems.address: Line {{line}}: write an address as "any", "host A.B.C.D" or "A.B.C.D wildcard".
problems.protocol: Line {{line}}: name the protocol: ip, icmp, tcp or udp.
problems.port: Line {{line}}: write a port as eq / neq / gt / lt <port> or range <low> <high> (a number or a name such as www).
problems.extra: Line {{line}}: unexpected words at the end: "{{text}}".
problems.remark: Line {{line}}: a remark needs text (up to 100 characters).

port.hint: Name or number of an access list; leave empty for none.
port.nameError: An access list name is one word without spaces.

cli.switchportGroup: This lab filters with access lists on routed ports, sub-interfaces and VLAN interfaces only, not on switchports.
cli.vtyOnly: In this lab, access-class works on the vty lines only (line vty 0 4).

notes.permitted: Access list {{acl}} ({{direction}} on {{iface}}): entry {{seq}} permits the packet.
notes.denied: Access list {{acl}} ({{direction}} on {{iface}}): entry {{seq}} denies the packet.
notes.implicitDeny: Access list {{acl}} ({{direction}} on {{iface}}): no entry matches, so the implicit "deny any" at the end drops the packet.
notes.noEntries: Access list {{acl}} ({{direction}} on {{iface}}) does not exist or has no entries, so the packet is allowed.
